<html>
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow">
    <meta name="referrer" content="never">
    <link rel="preload" href="https://pl.vixolity.com/jsx/jquery-3.7.1.min.js" as="script">
    <link rel="preload" href="https://pl.vixolity.com/libnew/jwplayer.js" as="script">
    <link rel="preload" href="https://pl.vixolity.com/libnew/all.bundlexp.js?t=1793664000" as="script">
    <link rel="icon" href="data:;base64,iVBORw0KGgo=">
    <script src="https://pl.vixolity.com/jsx/jquery-3.7.1.min.js"></script>
    <script src="https://pl.vixolity.com/libnew/jwplayer.js"></script>
    <script src="https://pl.vixolity.com/libnew/all.bundlexp.js?t=1793664000"></script>
    <style>
    :root {
        --gradient-primary: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.9), rgba(147, 51, 234, 0.9));
        --gradient-primary-light: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.13) !important;
        --gradient-primary-window: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5) !important;
    }

    html,
    body {
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        overflow: hidden;
    }

    .jw-settings-menu {
        background-color: var(--gradient-primary-window) !important;
        backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    }

    .jw-breakpoint-7 .jw-settings-menu {
        bottom: 80px !important;
        right: 12px !important;
        border-radius: 10px !important;
        height: auto !important;
        width: 25% !important;
    }

    .jw-controls.jw-reset.jw-settings-open {
        z-index: 9999;
    }
    
    .jw-settings-menu {
        border-radius: 10px !important;
    }
    .jw-settings-topbar {
        border-radius: 10px 10px 0px 0px !important;
    }
    .jw-settings-submenu .jw-submenu-topbar {
        background-color: var(--gradient-primary-window) !important;
        box-shadow: unset !important;
    }

    .jw-slider-horizontal.jw-chapter-slider-time .jw-slider-container .jw-timesegment-resetter {
        height: 15px !important;
    }

    .jw-controlbar {
        background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) !important;
    }

    .jw-display-icon-container .jw-svg-icon-play {
        height: auto !important;
        border: 1px solid #ddd;
        border-radius: 100px;
        color: #fff;
        border: none;
        background: var(--gradient-primary) !important;
        padding: 15px !important;
    }

    .jw-progress {
        background: var(--gradient-primary) !important;
    }

    .jw-preview {
        background-size: cover !important;
        background-repeat: no-repeat !important;
    }

    .jw-rightclick,
    .jw-rightclick-list {
        display: none !important;
        visibility: hidden !important;
    }

    .jw-time-time.jw-text.jw-reset {
        padding: 5px 10px !important;
        min-height: auto !important;
    }

    .jw-tooltip-time {
        bottom: -10px !important;
    }

    .quality-display-overlay {
        background: var(--gradient-primary) !important;
        z-index: unset !important;
    }

    .new-selector-btn {
        font-weight: bold !important;
        font-size: 12px !important;
        background: rgb(0 0 0 / 0.15) !important;
        border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1) !important;
    }

    .new-selector-btn.active {
        font-weight: bold !important;
        font-size: 12px !important;
        background: rgb(0 0 0 / 0.50) !important;
        border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3) !important;
    }

    .new-selector-btn:hover {
        font-weight: bold !important;
        font-size: 12px !important;
        background: rgb(0 0 0 / 0.50) !important;
        border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3) !important;
    }

    .new-style-selector {
        background: var(--gradient-primary-light) !important;
        /*box-shadow: 0px 0px 5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5), inset 0px 0px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);*/
        z-index: revert-layer !important;
    }

    

    /* Mobile Optimizations */
    /* Forward Button CSS - JWPlayer rewind mantığıyla aynı */
    .jw-state-idle .jw-icon-forward-display,
    .jwplayer.jw-state-buffering .jw-icon-forward-display,
    .jwplayer.jw-state-complete .jw-icon-forward-display,
    body .jw-error .jw-icon-forward-display,
    body .jwplayer.jw-state-error .jw-icon-forward-display {
        display: none !important;
    }

    .jw-flag-touch.jw-state-paused:not(.jw-breakpoint-1) .jw-icon-forward-display,
    .jw-flag-touch.jw-state-playing:not(.jw-breakpoint-1) .jw-icon-forward-display {
        display: none !important;
    }

    /* Mobile Optimizations */
    @media (max-width: 768px) {
        .new-selector-btn,
        .new-selector-btn.active {
            padding: 5px !important;
            font-size: 8px !important;
            touch-action: manipulation;
        }

        .new-style-selector {
            touch-action: manipulation;
            padding: 5px !important;
            top: 10px !important;
            gap: 5px !important;
            border-radius:3px !important;
            bottom: unset !important;
            z-index: 999999999999 !important;
        }

        .jw-icon.jw-icon-inline {
            width: 28px;
            padding: 5px;
        }

        .jw-icon-volume {
            display: none !important;
        }

        .quality-display-overlay {
            font-size: 8px !important;
            padding: 2px 6px !important;
        }

        .jw-slider-horizontal.jw-chapter-slider-time .jw-slider-container .jw-timesegment-resetter {
            height: 10px !important;
        }

        .jw-flag-touch .jw-slider-horizontal.jw-chapter-slider-time .jw-slider-container::before {
            height: auto;
            width: 100%;
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            display: block;
            bottom: calc(100% - 17px);
            left: 0;
        }
    }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div id="playerArea"></div>

</body>
</html>
